name: Souma Nozomi
source:
A second year student at Hamasaki High School, and [url=/c11631]Megumi[/url]'s younger twin sister. Nozomi has a weak body, so she spends most of her time in a hospital. Like her older sister, Nozomi also belongs to the arts club. Megumi and Nozomi sometimes pretend to be each other and change places with each other.
